poolV3.note: Shutdown coverage (2026-10-20): fresh PoolV3 whose refundPool lets anyone refund a Funded pool past its own deadline, so no contributor depends on the creator or a Provian key. Same constructor arguments as the PoolV3 it replaces (copied from it on-chain). Nothing else changed address; no PVT redeploy. Deployed from the relay's gas-only pool-keeper key (the deployer has no authority over the pool; admin = the bootstrap admin, a constructor argument).

safetyPolicy.note: The PoolV3 creation guard refuses nonexistent pools. The kernel and the other institutions retain their addresses.

retiredPoolV3.note: Retired PoolV3 has no current route or authority. It held no pool, funds or scheduled parameter at replacement.

ceiling.note: Fixed 7.5M Genesis and 10M combined caps bind from epoch 1. _applySchedules persists the mode and caps, so the scheduled policy binds every later epoch.

status.note: OBSERVED on Base mainnet. Every address equals its prediction. verify.mjs: 95 checks, 0 failed, at block 51826297. Snapshot block 51823797.

successorKernel.note: successor kernel + eligibility verifier. Genesis window 2026-08-03T00:00:00Z.. 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z (genesisEndsAt);  Fixed/MAX/MAX cap policy armed at epoch zero; epoch zero = arming block time + lead. The predecessor history is REPLAYED into a keyless migration distributor (same claims, same cursor sub-ranges; one successor batch per original recipient group) so every claimSettled / genesisAnchorUsed / genesisWalletGrossIssued entry and the cursor (9545) carry, and the distributor pays every predecessor balance 1:1.

orderingConstraint: Escrow MUST precede Court: the Court constructor takes the Escrow address and `escrowContract` has NO setter, so a Court deployed first can never be pointed at the right Escrow.

wiring.note: pvt == epochClock == issuanceIndex == the  successor kernel. All three are constructor immutables with no setter. Same admin EOA and same executor as the  set; no new authority.

carry.bonds: Every Active predecessor bond is seeded in the BondPool constructor (amount, level, created/renewed/deadline, requiredAtPost; pendingClaims 0) and emits BondCarried, never BondPosted. Its PVT backing arrives from the migration distributor, which pays the predecessor BondPool balance to the successor BondPool.
carry.bondBps: The predecessor BondPool's active bps overrides (depositFeeBps 0, renewalFeeBps 0) are seeded at the successor's epoch 0.
carry.escrows: Created (unfunded) predecessor escrows are seeded Created and emit EscrowCarried; the depositor funds them on the successor.
carry.servicedInPlace: A Funded/Disputed USDC escrow cannot move custody out of a non-custodial escrow; it completes on the predecessor EscrowV4 (its only kernel read is the time-derived epoch clock). See contracts/deployments/d486/*/plan.json servicedInPlace.

compiler.note: Must match contracts/foundry.toml exactly or bytecode verification fails.

predecessor.note: The  set, RETIRED by predecessor kernel HELD with its minter revoked, predecessor verifier HELD with its approver revoked; every balance, bond and unfunded escrow carried to the successor. History is not deleted.

supersedes.note: These five REPLACE the position-free set at nonces 2-6. Retired with a successor pointer; history is not deleted.
supersedes.retiredReason: Superseded by institution deployment. Safe to replace rather than migrate: verified on chain to hold no positions and to have all four cross-wiring setters unfired, so nothing is stranded.

alsoRetired.pvtV8Reason: The institution set now binds the PVT9 kernel 0x4Bf02d5C9bC4306c38603EF2aA164f2f2273bcd7. PVTv8 remains deployed history and is on the kernel config's own forbidden list.

postDeployVerification.note: scripts/d486/verify.mjs asserts every item and exits non-zero on any mismatch (95 checks on the rehearsal).
checks: every predecessor holder balance == its successor balance (institutions mapped), treasuries exact, distributor empty, no stray holder
successor totalSupply == predecessor totalSupply at the snapshot block
every predecessor claim claimSettled on both kernels; every Genesis anchor used on both; every Genesis wallet gross equal; cursor equal
epoch 0 Fixed/MAX/MAX; Genesis 2026-08-03 .. 2027-01-01; mint rate; treasuries; verifier configuration; relay minter + approver
predecessor kernel + verifier held, minter + approver revoked
institution wiring, bond + escrow seeds equal the predecessor state, bond backing == bonded total
a second grant on a used Genesis anchor is refused (GenesisAnchorAlreadyUsed)

shutdownCoverage.note: 2026-10-20: every fund-holding institution audited for a relay-independent exit; only PoolV3 lacked one (a Funded pool left only via its creator or the admin). The replaced pool never held a pool: 0 USDC, 0 PVT, no schedules, 0 logs from deploy to the replacement. Evidence: contracts/deployments/shutdown-coverage/.

retiredPoolV3.note: Retired PoolV3 refuses contribution to a nonexistent pool and retains its constructor-bound Base assets, admin, treasury and kernel clock. The active pool is named in contracts.poolV3.
